name: John E. Rubin, MD
title: Assistant Professor, Co-Director
notableTitle: New York-Presbyterian Hospital and Weill Cornell
bio: John E. Rubin, MD is an Assistant Professor of Clinical Anesthesiology and Assistant Attending Anesthesiologist at NewYork Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medicine. He earned a Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry from the University of Minnesota and attended medical school at New York Medical College. Dr. Rubin completed his residency in Anesthesiology at NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital-Weill Cornell Medical Center, where he served as chief resident in his final year of training. He also competed a fellowship at NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital-Weill Cornell Medical Center in Regional Anesthesiology and Acute Pain Medicine. Dr. Rubin is a national leader in the use of extended reality (XR) in medicine and is a founding member of the American Medical Extended Reality Association (AMXRA). He is the Co Director of the Extended Reality Anesthesiology Immersion Laboratory (XRAIL) at Weill Cornell Anesthesiology. Along with his collaborators, Dr. Rubin investigates how to integrate XR and artificial intelligence (AI) for training in procedural tasks within anesthesiology, for simulation education, for the development of soft skills (power skills and bias training), and for pre-procedural planning for clinical care.

name: John Gauntt
title: Creative Director
bio: John Gauntt is the Creative Director of the Seattle AI Film Festival and a founderof Culture & Code , a B2B podcast and newsletter focused on Generative AI for CreativeProfessionals. He is also the Seattle Chapter President of the Applied AI Association.John’s analysis of technology’s impact on media and marketing have been featured inThe Economist and eMarketer while his public speaking includes SXSW, Infinity FestivalHollywood, the Monaco Media Forum, and Podcast Movement Evolutions.John's audio stories and AI short films have won numerous awards including two SignalAwards from the Webbys organization, Official Selection for On Air Fest, AIFilm3, andthe Philip K. Dick Science Fiction Festival.He holds dual degrees in English Literature and Computer Information Systems plus a2nd Degree Black Belt in Brazilian Jiujitsu.

name: Jordan Thiel
title: Product Manager Lead
bio: Jordan is the lead Product Manager for Horizon Creation Tools at Meta, where he has focused on VR development for Workrooms and Horizon Worlds for the past three years. With a decade of experience as a Product Manager and a programming background, Jordan previously led teams at Zoom and other hardware and software companies to deliver innovative solutions to market. Based in Austin, TX, he enjoys working on software projects in his free time as a solopreneur and enjoy family time with his wife and 1 year old son.

name: Julian Park
title: CEO
bio: Julian Park is the Co-founder and CEO of Bezi, a collaborative spatial design tool. Built on the web, Bezi enables design teams to easily turn ideas into 3D designs and interactive prototypes. Prior to Bezi, Julian was a software engineering leader at Oculus heading key projects across VR multitasking and UI frameworks. Julian holds a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of California, Berkeley.

name: Kachina Studer
title: Co-Founder
notableTitle: XR and AI Lab Lead at Harvard and MIT
bio: Kachina’s work is dedicated to advancing stateof the art in visualization tools, methods, and techniques for scientificresearch, training and education. With a diverse background in architecture,generative design, and the fine arts, she brings a unique perspective tomultimodal problem-solving. Kachina is committed to fostering a culture ofinnovation and collaboration within teams, building strong relationships withstakeholders, and driving the implementation of immersive technology and AIdesign in educational practices. Her passion lies in empowering people toexplore their creativity and learning through immersive mediums and AI. “I could not be more grateful for theopportunities I have been given as a special guest speaker nationwide at AWE,MIT, Harvard, Berklee College of Music, NYU, Boston University, Venture Cafe,and several other organizations, and I am proud to be a founding member of theAugmented Reality conference, AR in Action ( now imagination in action )”

name: Kailin Zhu
title: Staff Designer
bio: Kailin Zhu is a design lead and creative technologist exploring new forms of creative tools and immersive media. Currently at Adobe, Kailin leads the design of 0-to-1 spatial media creation tools that enable new ways to create spatial content with the power of AI. Previously, she worked at Unity Technologies and ustwo, designing consumer-facing platforms across XR, gaming, and interactive media, shaping how playful interactive experiences are created, scaled, and enjoyed by audiences worldwide. Kailin is also an independent game designer whose work has been showcased at E3, IndieCade, the Smithsonian American Art Museum, and SXSW.

name: Kate Donovan
title: Clinical Director of Innovation
bio: Kate Donovan, PhD, MBA, MS is the Clinical Director of Innovation at Boston Children's Hospital for the Inpatient Medical Programs and Pediatric Intermediate Care Program at Boston Children’s Hospital and is also an advisor to the Innovation Digital Health Accelerator and Immersive Design Systems at Boston Children's. Dr. Donovan is the founder of mARk, an AR app that brings medical equipment into the homes of our young patients to help them prepare and understand how their environment will be once discharged from the hospital. She is co-founder of the CAITLYNN Program, Hacking Pediatrics (the only pediatric healthcare hackathon in the Northeast), and the Small Talk Podcast (an award winning pediatric focused podcast) . She is also a co-founder of medVR (medical XR bootcamp and accelerator), and the VP of Innovation for the Amercian Medical Extended Reality Association. Dr. Donovan is the Senior Editor for the Journal of Medical Extended Reality (JMXR). brought XR to the hospital 17 years ago and have been in the space ever since. She develops and utilizes XR with pediatric patients and for clinical training at Boston Children’s Hospital. In additional to over 100 experiences that have built and deployed in-house, Boston Children’s was the first medical institution to have a medical app in the Apple Vision Pro app store - CyranoHealth - an app that helps with nurse training and communication. Kate understands the pain points in the clinical environment and beyond and augments them with XR.

name: Ke Jing
title: PM Lead
bio: Dr. Ke Jing is a Product Manager at PICO, ByteDance, where he focuses on XR developer technologies and tools. Prior to joining PICO, he worked as a Software Engineer at Unity on the XR Interaction Toolkit, and as a Tech Lead at Genies, developing avatar applications. Ke has served as a judge for MIT Reality Hack 2024 and AI Design 2025. He holds a PhD in Informatics from the University of California, Irvine, where he studied XR, human-computer interaction, and design.

name: Ken Zolot
title: Senior Lecturer in Brain and Cognitive Sciences
bio: Ken Zolot is a Senior Lecturer at MIT (Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Mechanical Engineering) and a Professor of Creative Entrepreneurship at the Berklee College of Music. He leads innovative courses—such as and —and created MIT’s Innovation Teams Initiative. An experienced startup mentor, he co-founded ventures like Rethink Robotics and Egenera, Inc., and has advised numerous organizations, including Techstars and the Deshpande Foundation. Ken holds an MS from MIT and earned his BS in Computer Science and BA in Philosophy from Syracuse University. The Founder's Journey Designing Virtual Worlds

name: Kevin ODonovan
organization: A Bit of This and That
title: Technology Evangelist
bio: As a Technology Evangelist with decades of experience in technology, Kevin helps companies internalize the impact of new technologies by bridging the gap between the art of the possible and what is feasible today. His work focuses on technology advocacy—sharing innovative insights through discoveries, paid engagements, and compelling keynote presentations—and technical advisory, providing fee-based, go-to-market strategies to refine technology and sales approaches.Known for his engaging speaking style and his ability to challenge assumptions with an outside-in perspective, Kevin has held senior leadership roles at Compaq, HP, and Intel, where he led worldwide energy sales. Currently, he co-chairs the VRARA Industrial Metaverse & Digital Twin Committee, is a member of the Siemens Influencer Community, and is recognized as a top 10 Thought Leader on Thinkers360 for Digital Twin, Metaverse, and Renewable Energy.

name: Lisa Park
organization: University of Pennsylvania (Stuart Weitzman School of Design)
title: Full-time Lecturer
bio: Lisa Park is an artist working with emerging technologies to create interactive installations and performances that explore human emotion and connection in the digital age. Her work has also been featured in media outlets including Art21, Artnet, The New York Times Magazine, Wired, and PBS. She received a BFA from ArtCenter College of Design and an MPS from NYU, and currently teaches in the Undergraduate Fine Arts and Design program at the University of Pennsylvania.

name: Louis Rosenberg
title: CEO, Chief Scientist
bio: Louis Rosenberg, PhD is an early pioneer of virtual and augmented reality and a longtime AI researcher. His work began over thirty years ago in VR labs at NASA and the U.S. Air Force where he developed the first mixed reality system ( ) enabling users to reach out and interact with a combined spatial reality of real and virtual objects. In 1993, he founded the early VR company Immersion Corporation and brought it public on Nasdaq. Virtual Fixtures platform In 2004 he founded Outland Research, an early developer of augmented reality and spatial media technology acquired by Google. In 2014 he founded , a company focused on amplifying the intelligence of networked human groups in pursuit of . He received his PhD from Stanford University, was a tenured professor at California State University, and has been awarded over 300 patents for VR, AR, and AI technologies. His latest book, , comes out in March from Hachette. Unanimous AI Collective Superintelligence Our Next Reality

name: Manuel Sainsily
title: Global Speaker on AI & XR
bio: Manuel Sainsily is a TEDx Speaker, and XR & AI Instructor at McGill University, UMass Boston & OCADU. Born in Guadeloupe, and a Canadian citizen based in Montreal where he completed his Master of Science in Computer Science, he is a trilingual global speaker (45 talks in 29 cities in 2024), designer, and educator with over 15 years of experience who champions the responsible use and understanding of artificial intelligence. From delivering a masterclass on AI ethics and speaking at worldwide tech, film, and gaming conferences, to being celebrated by NVIDIA, Mozilla Rise25 & Skillshare, and producing art exhibitions with Meta, OpenAI & VIFFest, Manuel amplifies the conversation around cultural preservation and emerging technologies such as spatial computing, AI, real-time 3D, haptics, and BCI through powerful keynotes and curated events.

name: Mark Zhang
title: Medical Director of the Digital Innovation Hub
bio: Haipeng (Mark) Zhang DO, MMSc, FAMIA, is the Associate Chief Medical Information Officer of Digital Innovation and the Medical Director of the Digital Innovation Hub at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Associate Program Director of the Clinical Informatics and Innovation Fellowship at Mass General Brigham, Palliative Care consultant at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and Instructor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School. He is the founder of Palliative Care Fast Facts for iOS and Android mobile applications, the co-founder of Cake, a venture backed company focused on advance care planning, and also founded and was the first president of American Medical Informatics Association Clinical Informatics Fellows (ACIF), the national organization for clinical informatics fellows. He also founded and is the president of the American Medical Extended Reality Association (AMXRA), the medical society for medical extended reality. In his current role as a leader in digital health implementation and digital innovation at Mass General Brigham, Dr. Zhang has created award-winning applications including COVID Pass and Mass General Brigham Prescreen.

profiles.title: Medical Director of the Digital Innovation Hub
profiles.bio: Haipeng (Mark) Zhang DO, MMSc, FAMIA, is the Associate Chief Medical Information Officer of Digital Innovation and the Medical Director of the Digital Innovation Hub at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Associate Program Director of the Clinical Informatics and Innovation Fellowship at Mass General Brigham, Palliative Care consultant at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and Instructor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School. He is the founder of Palliative Care Fast Facts for iOS and Android mobile applications, the co-founder of Cake, a venture backed company focused on advance care planning, and also founded and was the first president of American Medical Informatics Association Clinical Informatics Fellows (ACIF), the national organization for clinical informatics fellows. He also founded and is the president of the American Medical Extended Reality Association (AMXRA), the medical society for medical extended reality. In his current role as a leader in digital health implementation and digital innovation at Mass General Brigham, Dr. Zhang has created award-winning applications including COVID Pass and Mass General Brigham Prescreen.

profiles.title: President of AMXRA
profiles.bio: Haipeng (Mark) Zhang DO, MMSc, FAMIA, is the President and Founder of the American Medical Extended Reality Association. He was previously the Associate Chief Medical Information Officer of Digital Innovation and the Medical Director of the Digital Innovation Hub at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Associate Program Director of the Clinical Informatics and Innovation Fellowship at Mass General Brigham, Palliative Care consultant at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and Instructor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School. He is the founder of Palliative Care Fast Facts for iOS and Android mobile applications, the co-founder of Cake, a venture backed company focused on advance care planning, and also founded and was the first president of American Medical Informatics Association Clinical Informatics Fellows (ACIF), the national organization for clinical informatics fellows. Mark is triple board certified in Internal Medicine, Palliative Medicine, and Clinical Informatics. He also works as the Chief Innovation Officer for the United States Veterans Health Administration.

name: Martin Sawtell
title: XR Lead, CSG CTO
bio: Martin is the XR lead at CSG CTO, where he explores use cases, technology platform and implications of compute in the space around us (virtual or physical). Exploring the promise of the Metaverse, GenAI tools and solving the problems of what an XR device can be, how it is used, and how it is deployed to commercial effect is his interest. Before Dell Martin was the co-founder of a VR med tech startup, which used eye-tracking to create new ways of detecting eye disease and neurological conditions. Prior to that he has a decade of experience in feature film Visual Effects, specializing in dynamics simulation and rendering for films such as Star Wars and Ready Player One.

name: Matt Miesnieks
title: CO-FOUNDER & CEO
bio: Matt is a serial entrepreneur with over 15 years building at the intersection of computer vision, spatial computing, and applied AI. He began his career as an Engineer in Sydney before spending a decade leading Enterprise Sales for frontier technology companies across APAC. He then led business at Layar — one of the first AR platforms — and founded Dekko, a mobile computer vision startup. In 2016 he co-founded 6D.ai, which pioneered the AR Cloud: a real-time 3D scene understanding platform that enabled mobile devices to reconstruct and reason about physical spaces. 6D.ai was acquired by Niantic in 2020, where its technology became core infrastructure for large-scale AR mapping. Matt leads the company's flagship product for CV developers. He is focused on building the next generation of predictive world models, applying JEPA-based architectures to give computer vision developers research-grade scene understanding infrastructure. He is a frequent speaker and writer on spatial computing, physical AI, and the future of machine perception.

name: Max Zhaoyi Wang
title: Designer
bio: Max Wang is a design researcher at Harvard GSD working at the intersection of ecology, computation, and spatial systems. Her work explores how emerging technologies—from XR to material systems—can reshape how we perceive, design, and inhabit environments. She leads with curiosity, builds across disciplines, and is particularly interested in translating experimental ideas into real-world impact.

name: Meg Murphy
organization: Founding Advisor, Harvard HealthLab Accelerators; Founder, Blue42 Labs
title: storytelling expert and pitch coach
bio: Meg Murphy is a Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist and co-founder of Harvard HealthLab Accelerators, a social impact accelerator based at Harvard University. She is now one of the founders of Blue42 Labs, a global innovation ecosystem for emerging social entrepreneurs. Previously, Meg worked in strategic communications for leadership at Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A former journalist, Meg has written for various newspapers and weeklies, including The Boston Globe, The Globe and Mail, The Village Voice, and NOW Magazine. She holds degrees from the University of Toronto and Columbia University’s Graduate School of Journalism.

name: Michael Levine
title: CEO
bio: Mike Levine is the founder and CEO of Mystic Moose, creator of Planet Mojo. He has been working with interactive and digital media for over 25 years. A veteran of LucasArts Entertainment, Mike sat on the Technology Council at Skywalker Ranch, created & ran the Visual FX group at LucasArts, and developed several breakthrough art production techniques on classic LEC games. After Lucas, Mike formed Puffin Designs with ILM veterans, a VFX Software Tools company that was later acquired by Pinnacle. Mike and his last company HappyGiant are a recognized leader in the VR/AR space, working with large brands, companies, and speaking at industry leading events such as AWE, ARIA(MIT), and others. Sam & Max: This Time It’s Virtual!, a VR game bringing back the iconic gaming duo, was their latest game before moving to the Web3 space.

name: Michelle Cortese
title: Design Lead Manager
bio: Michelle is an augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR) designer, artist and futurist. She splits her professional time between design leadership at Meta Reality Labs and teaching at NYU. Her work investigates the ethical transmutation of communication and expression across new technologies and formats. Michelle has authored AR/VR design research published via Bloomsbury Visual Arts, Meta Research, IEEE, OneZero, MIT's Immerse Journal and more; she has also exhibited work at CES, Tribeca Film Festival, SXSW, and Sundance Film Festival.

name: Mike Pell
title: Director
bio: Bold, insightful, and uncompromising, Mike Pell is widely recognized as a world-class Designer and industry thought leader in the fields of Innovation, Visualization , and Data + AI. Pell currently leads The Microsoft Garage in New York City, where he regularly disrupts the thinking, strategy, and business models of the world’s top companies and organizations. His evolution from intrepid entrepreneur, to VC-backed startup veteran, to corporate man for Adobe and Microsoft has given him a unique perspective on how to combine business, design, and technology to create breakthrough experiences.

name: Min Lang
organization: AR/VR Lab at Mass General Hospital
title: Neuroradiology Fellow
bio: is the Director of Innovation and Research at the Mass General Brigham Medical Extended Reality Lab, where he advances the application of immersive technologies in clinical care, medical education, and diagnostic imaging. He is a founding member and the Vice President of Operations of the American Medical Extended Reality Association (AMXRA) and serves as an Associate Editor for the Journal of Medical Extended Reality the first peer-reviewed journal dedicated to the field. His published work spans MXR applications in medical education, the establishment of hospital-based XR labs, and frameworks for integrating extended reality into clinical workflows. Dr. Lang is also a neuroradiologist at Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Assistant Professor at Harvard Medical School, and Venture Partner at One Six 8 Ventures. Min Lang, MD, MSc ,

name: Monica Arés
title: Founder
notableTitle: Former Head of Immersive Learning at Meta
bio: Monica is a leading expert in immersive technology, using it to empower people to learn, connect, and create in ways they never could before. She is deeply committed to using XR technology to increase access to education and fundamentally transform the way we learn. As the former Head of Immersive Learning at Meta, and a pioneering leader on Interactive Learning Labs at Amazon, Monica is a visionary and leading figure in the field of immersive education. She is dedicated to developing innovative products, programs, and content to make learning more powerful and accessible.

name: Nancy Soignoli
title: Product Manager and Strategist
bio: Nancy Soignoli is a dynamic Product Manager and Strategist with a proven track record of driving innovation and delivering impactful, data-driven solutions across industries, including e-commerce, consulting, and emerging technologies. With deep expertise in product strategy, business intelligence, and team leadership, she excels in navigating ambiguity, identifying market opportunities, and shaping scalable solutions that transform organizations. She brings a user-centric, agile mindset to her work, consistently turning bold ideas into practical solutions that drive long-term value. Nancy holds a Master of Science from the University of Notre Dame in engineering and entrepreneurship and a Bachelor of Arts in chemistry from Saint Anselm College.

name: Nara Huang
title: Project Manager / Curator
bio: Nara Huang is a curator and project manager specializing in contemporary art, with experience in both corporate companies and art institutions. She has independently curated multiple museum exhibitions, and played key project management roles in biennials, design fairs, and land art festivals.

name: Nengjie Qu
title: Designer
bio: Ex-architectural designer with passion on HCI/Product Design

name: Nick Cherukuri
title: Founder
bio: Mr. Nick Cherukuri is the founder of ThirdEye, a leader in Mixed Reality and Artificial Intelligence. He was awarded Forbes 30 Under 30 for enterprise technology, a TEDx speaker, a finalist for Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year, has spoken at major world tech conferences such as CES & AWE , holds multiple patents in the MR/AI field and completed a successful M&A Exit. As CEO, he led ThirdEye’s technology to be used by the US Department of Defense, hospitals, and organizations worldwide. He was the founding member of the University of Pennsylvania Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality club. In his spare time, Nick also enjoys rowing, golfing, running & doing charity work.

name: Nicole Mills
title: Director of Language Programs
bio: Nicole Mills is the Joint Director of Language Programs in the Department of Romance Languages & Literatures and lecturer in the Graduate School of Education at Harvard University. She teaches courses in French, language pedagogy, and technology enhanced language learning and serves as the advisor for Harvard’s Bok Certificate in Teaching Languages and Cultures. Her research interests are associated with the psychology of language learning and their intersection with virtual and simulated environments in language learning, with a particular focus on artificial intelligence and virtual reality applications. Her book Perspectives on Teaching Language and Content (co-authored with Stacey Katz Bourns and Cheryl Krueger) was published in 2020 with Yale University Press and she has various publications in the Modern Language Journal, the Foreign Language Annals, Language Learning, the CALICO journal, the International Journal of Applied Linguistics and in various edited volumes. She holds a Ph.D. in Educational Studies and French from Emory University.

name: Nils Pihl
title: CEO
bio: Nils Pihl is an entrepreneur, behavioral engineer, and social transhumanist with a deep focus on the intersection of modern technology and human behavior. As CEO of Auki Labs, Nils is helping build a decentralized network that helps make the physical world browsable, searchable and navigable to robots and AI. the real world web, A thought leader in the realms of technology and memetics, Nils applies his expertise in meme theory, game theory, and behavioral psychology to craft compelling narratives that shape the path of the AI revolution, future of augmented reality, and the acceleration of robotic technologies. His work spans from neural interfaces to large-scale behavioral analytics, showcasing his innovative approach to integrating new technology with real human society.

name: Nix Liu Xin
title: Founder, Onceness / Play.Work Labs
bio: Nix Liu Xin, a computational media artist, director, designer, and Harvard graduate, is the founder and CEO of Onceness, an experiential AI company. Its mission is to enable everyone to create and share interactive experiences through AI-driven intelligent world-making and 4D volumetric media. He was named to the AACYF 30 Under 30 and has received accolades such as the Harvard Design Studies Domain Award, the CGarchitect 3D Awards, and the MIT AI Film Hack Award for Best Picture. Additionally, Nix was featured as an artist at the Lianzhou Photography Biennale. He is also the co-founder of the HarvardXR Conference and the Creative.Tech Community.

name: Olivia Gong
title: Marketing Strategist
bio: Olivia Gong is a Master in Design Studies candidate at the Harvard Graduate School of Design, focusing on digital marketing. She completed her undergraduate degree at the University of Southern California’s Interactive Media & Games Division. Her experience includes global game publishing and marketing analytics, working on creator campaigns, player engagement analysis, and go-to-market strategies.

name: Omer Liran, MD, MSHS
title: Co-Director
bio: Omer Liran, MD, MSHS, is a physician-innovator and Assistant Professor at Cedars-Sinai, where he co-directs Virtual Medicine and provides expert care through the psychiatry consult and liaison service. As a full-stack developer and a passion for healthcare transformation, Dr. Liran explores how emerging technologies such as VR and AI can enhance patient outcomes and streamline healthcare delivery. His unique ability to design and rapidly iterate medical applications, informed by direct patient feedback, bridges clinical practice and cutting-edge technology.

name: Ori Inbar
title: CO-Founder and CEO
bio: Ori Inbar is the founder of Super Ventures, the first early-stage fund dedicated to Augmented Reality (AR).Ori is also the co-founder and CEO of AWE XR, a global community dedicated to advancing Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR). Since 2010, over 5,000 companies and 50,000 professionals have trusted AWE to connect, learn, and grow their businesses in the XR ecosystem—via conferences, meetups, classes, award competitions, industry news, and thousands of free videos about everything XR.In 2009, Ori was the co-founder and CEO of Ogmento, one of the first venture-backed companies conceived from the ground up to develop and publish augmented reality games—games that are played in the real world.Ori has been an enterprising champion of the augmented reality industry since 2007. He established —a leading augmented reality blog that helped popularize AR—and in 2010 co-founded the Augmented World Expo (formerly ARE), the world's largest and most influential conference for AR, now in its 13th year.Ori is a recognized speaker in the AR industry, a lecturer at NYU, as well as a sought-after adviser and board member for augmented reality startups.Previously, as Senior Vice President of Solution Marketing for SAP’s platform, Ori was responsible for the positioning and marketing of SAP NetWeaver—which, under his leadership, grew from a mere concept to a billion-dollar business for SAP.Prior to SAP, Ori joined TopTier Software as one of the first employees of the start-up.He led the development and introduction to the market of more than 15 multimedia and business applications, including the world’s leading enterprise portal, which in 2001 was acquired by SAP for $400 million.Ori has a double major in Computer Science and Cinema from Tel Aviv University and is a graduate of the INSEAD University Business Leadership Program. Games Alfresco

name: Phil Chen
title: Founding Partner
bio: Phil Chen is a senior advisor at Race Capital, a serial entrepreneur and investor. Prior, Phil was the founder of (leading VR headset), Exodus (world’s first crypto phone), Alex eReader (acquired by B&N), partner at Horizons Ventures and led numerous investments including Improbable (valued at $2B), Beats (acquired by Apple for $3B), Sandbox VR (valued at $400M), among others. HTC Vive Phil joined HTC late 2007 and shipped the and helped grow HTC from a USD$2B to USD$ 35B market cap company. Phil is a proud Taiwanese entrepreneur and received his B.A and B.S in Mathematics and Physics from UCSD and an M.Div from Fuller Seminary. He is the happy husband of Tanya and proud father of Miles, Naomi and Olive. world’s first Android phone

name: Qian Xiang
title: Visual Designer
bio: Qian Xiang is an interdisciplinary designer and visual artist, her practice focuses on responsive environments, immersive experience design, and non-linear Human-AI collaboration. Her work investigates how generative design frameworks can embed open-ended dialogue and creative co-creation between humans and AI. Through experiments with physical AI, generative systems, and spatial media, she examines how decentralized and nonlinear narrative structures can reshape storytelling, immersive environments, and the production of experimental film and media.

name: Rex Dickson
title: Associate Design Director
bio: Rex Dickson is a 30-year veteran of the video game industry. He has 16 shipped titles as lead designer/design director that have collectively sold over 40 million units worldwide. Rex is experienced in all aspects of game design and production with the ability to own, communicate, and implement the vision. Rex has over 20 years' experience in staff and project management, where he has driven all aspects of design from concept through completion. Rex has lectured at a variety of schools including University of Advancing Technology, Art Institute, University of Southern California, Otis College of Art and Design. Marist College and FIEA (UCF).

name: Rika Nakazawa
title: Global VP
bio: Rika is a technology leader, VC investor, best-selling author, and frequent public speaker on technology-powered industry transformation. She is Global Vice President with NTT’s New Ventures & Innovation team where she is building Agile Co-innovation practices for emerging technologies like 5G, Edge Computing, AI, and IoT. In her additional role as Head of Sustainability for Americas at NTT, Rika is driving NTT's sustainability ambition in operations while also orchestrating the go-to-market for NTT's climate-positive solutions across their portfolio of digital infrastructure solutions. For 2 consecutive years in 2022 and 2023, Rika has been awarded “Power 70” and “Power 80” recognition for the Women of Channel awards with The Channel Co’s CRN network. She has also been ranked as "Top 100 in Emerging Tech" by Women of the Future. Trilingual in Japanese, German, and English, Rika grew up in Japan and moved to the US to attend Princeton University. Rika has since worked internationally in senior executive roles in strategy, business development, consulting, and marketing with Fortune 500 companies - Accenture, NVIDIA, Capgemini, Sony - and Silicon Valley startups. She is a digital innovation veteran and has served on multiple boards in Next-Gen Computing, XR/VR/AR, Cybersecurity, and AI ecosystems. Rika is currently board chair at STRIDES AI - a social impact venture that is advancing diversity in senior leadership with an AI platform, and a board member of Venus Shell Systems - a circular and blue economy enterprise. Rika is the best-selling author of “Dear Chairwoman” - featuring the trials and triumphs of women corporate board leaders. Her next book, featuring the intersection of sustainability, digital innovation, and the pandemic, is called “Beyond the Black Swan: How the Pandemic and Digital Innovation Intensified the Sustainability Imperative - Everywhere" which was just released by Taylor & Francis in January 2024.

name: Roger Daglius Dias
title: Assistant Professor
bio: Roger Daglius Dias, MD, Ph.D., MBA is a physician-scientist, Assistant Professor of Emergency Medicine at Harvard Medical School, and Director of Research and Innovation at Mass General Brigham, where he leads the Human Factors and Cognitive Engineering lab, focusing on the intersection between technology and medicine. Dr. Dias’s work on Medical Extended Reality (XR) has been funded by NASA and DoD and currently, he is working on Generative XR merging Generative AI + XR to make easier, faster, and cheaper the creation of XR experiences. Dr. Dias is also the co-founder of Xtory, an XR Creation & Marketplace Platform for Generative XR.

name: Ruoya Sheng
title: PM Lead
bio: Ruoya Sheng is a Product Lead at ByteDance PICO, driving the development of Spatial Web technologies to help bridge traditional 2D GUI application developers into the XR domain. She also leads AI applications in XR, spearheading research in Spatial ML. Prior to PICO, Ruoya worked at Meta Reality Labs, where she spent five years leading cross-functional teams in developing AI-driven XR features. She played a key role in launching AI-powered products across Meta’s platforms, optimizing AR application performance, and significantly improving XR software stability. Before joining Meta, Ruoya was a Technical AI Product Manager at ObEN Inc., where she led research and development teams in building AI-driven voice and avatar technologies. She managed the development of Text-to-Speech (TTS), Face Tracking, and Voice Conversion SDKs—successfully delivering AI-powered solutions to major partners including Tencent, SoftBank, and SM Entertainment. Ruoya holds dual degrees in Computer Science and Finance from the University of Southern California. With deep expertise in AI and XR, she is passionate about building intelligent, immersive experiences that push the boundaries of spatial computing.

name: Rus Gant
title: Visualization Lab Lead
bio: Rus Gant is a well-regarded international multi-technology artist, XR architect, visual computing engineer, educator and visual futurist. He is currently on the Research staff at Harvard University in the Department of Earth & Planetary Sciences, where he currently runs the Visualization Research Laboratory and the Virtual Harvard Project, he was recently a Research Fellow at MIT at the Center for Media Studies and for 10 years was adjunct faculty at Tokyo’s Showa Women’s University. He is currently pursuing work in Real-time XR+AI for scientific teaching and research, this includes the future of real-time XR spatial imaging for immersive telepresence. He is a noted historian and lecturer on the history of XR technology. He is a past fellow at the MIT Center for Advanced Visual Studies, was director of the Visualization Group of MIT's Project Athena and a Fellow at the Center for Creative Inquiry at Carnegie Mellon University.

name: Russell Sng
title: Developer Advocate
bio: Russell is an avid gamer who turned that passion into a career in game development to create unique experiences in virtual space. He’s been specializing in VR for the last three years. By integrating his background in marketing with developer insights, he is excited to enable other creators to take their projects to new heights with cutting-edge Unity features. Past projects include implementing rehabilitation tasks in VR for healthcare, game design and character animation in AI, non-traditional control schemes like eye tracking, navigation in Unity for accessibility, and integrating external hardware like the Myo armband into a gesture-based wizard spellcasting game.

name: Ryan Canuel
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Ryan Canuel is the CEO and co-founder of Petricore, Inc., a studio creating innovative games and interactive experiences for emerging platforms, including Mythic Realms, an upcoming XR title developed with Meta. Since 2015, Petricore has worked with major brands like Mitsubishi, Star Trek, and Burger King while also launching original games that have reached millions worldwide. He has spoken on XR at GDC, AWE, MIT, and Northeastern University and previously taught AR design as an adjunct professor at Becker College.

name: Sam Magee
title: Director, LPCE
bio: Sam builds and connects creativity, innovation, and social impact entrepreneurship communities. He is the Director on Creativity and Entrepreneurship for the Lemann Program at Harvard College. Previously, he was the Entrepreneur-in-Residence at Harvard University's Operation Impact and an arts administrator at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology where he founded the Creative Arts Competition. He founded BLUE42, an innovation architecture consultancy in 2026. Sam holds a patent for a hardware/software device that detects freefall and deploys an airbrake for drones.

name: Sanya Chauhan
title: Masters of Business Analytics Candidate '24
bio: Sanya Chauhan is a passionate Woman in Tech currently pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at the . She is particularly excited about the potential of Extended Reality (XR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to shape the future, and how these technologies can be used to create positive change in the world. MIT Sloan School of Management Sanya's academic background lies in statistics with her bachelor’s degree from in India, and she has actively explored machine learning, business analytics, and data science through coursework and internships at Fortune 500 companies in the Finance and Tech Industry. Her experience includes working in GenAI, natural language processing, and machine learning. Saya has recently concluded a project with Schneider Electric and is currently involved in projects with Liberty Mutual Insurance and Bangkok Bank. Lady Shri Ram College At MIT, Sanya has continued to delve into analytics, AI, and their applications. Her enthusiasm for technology extends beyond her academic pursuits. She is actively involved in the MIT Sloan community, serving as the Corporate Relations Manager for the , and being an active part of clubs like Sloan Women in Management and the Tech Club. Sanya enjoys participating in tech and business competitions. In the past, she has secured top positions in Ernst & Young’s Next Generation Women Competition, Google x MIT Product Hackathon and more! Analytics Career Night Sanya is excited to manage external relations for HarvardXR Conference 2024 and be a part to facilitate discussions about XR shaping the future of work!

name: Selina Yanan Zhou
title: Designer
bio: Creative Technologist busy playing pokopia recently...

name: Shelley Petersen
title: CEO, XR Industry Pioneer
bio: XR Industry Pioneer: Prior Microsoft Director of Mixed Reality, AR Fellow at Lockheed Martin Space, Highlighted by Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, Forbes, WSJ, MIT, Stanford Univ; Advisory Boards: Barbara Bush Foundation, Augmented World Expo, HarvardXR, Southern Methodist University Shelley Peterson’s decades of experience across the XR industry have resulted in repeated demonstrations of the value of XR across numerous manufacturing programs, including Lockheed Martin’s civil and defense space initiatives. As a Director within Microsoft's Mixed Reality organization, Shelley led the strategic implementation of XR technology. Early in her professional career, Shelley founded a business providing capabilities related to aircraft distributed mission training and a monocular system for SOCOM. Her experience includes software development on the B-1 Bomber simulator, electronic warfare capabilities at E-Systems, and the Space-Based Infrared Systems (SBIRS) satellite program, where she served as the first certified mission management crew member and instructor. Shelley also serves on advisory boards for the Barbara Bush Foundation, AWE, and Southern Methodist University.

name: Simson Garfinkel
title: Chief Scientist
bio: Simson Garfinkel is the Chief Scientist of BasisTech, LLC., a technology accelerator in Somerville Massachusetts, and a Lecturer at Harvard University, where he co-teaches "Defense Against the Dark Arts (Cybersecurity Edition)" a first year seminar, and "AC221: Critical Thinking in Data Science," an advanced course about data science ethics. Simson Garfinkel holds seven US patents and has published more than 70 research articles in computer security and digital forensics. He is a fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), and a member of the National Association of Science Writers. Garfinkel is the co-author of Law and Policy for the Quantum Age, which explores the technology, history, policy, and business implications of quantum information science. As a journalist, he has written about science, technology, and technology policy in the popular press since 1983, and has won several national journalism awards. Garfinkel received three Bachelor of Science degrees from MIT in 1987, a Master of Science in Journalism from Columbia University in 1988, and a Ph.D. in Computer Science from MIT in 2005.

name: Sophia Liao
title: Designer
bio: Sophia is a designer working across architecture, ecology, and computation, exploring spatial systems, AI, and human–environment interaction.

name: Stewart Smith
title: Product Design Director, AI&ML
bio: Stewart playfully innovates across machine learning, spatial computing, and quantum computing—one foot planted in software engineering and the other in art and design. With his MFA from Yale University, Stewart’s artwork has been exhibited at the Museum of Modern Art in New York, ZKM in Germany, the SFMOMA in San Francisco, and is in the permanent collection of the Fondation Cartier in Paris. As a coder, his work has been featured on the Google Search homepage as the Rubik’s Cube Google Doodle, as the Autocompose feature in Yahoo Mail (awarded a machine learning patent two years prior to Google’s Smart Reply feature), and as the XR hand controller toolkit for LCD Soundsystem’s “Dance Tonite” virtual reality music video. His numerous open-source personal projects span from hand pose recognition for XR interfaces, to browser-based music synthesizers, to the world’s first open-source music video for Grandaddy’s “Jed’s Other Poem.” He’s also the creator of Quantum JavaScript, a quantum circuit simulator and circuit composer that can be used to drive real quantum hardware. Stewart recently served as an Artist in Residence at Yale University’s Quantum Institute and currently leads Unity’s product design for advanced AI & ML projects. What really makes him happy is partnering with smart friends to take on the impossible—or the ridiculous.

name: Talis Reks
title: AR/VR/Gaming/Big Data IT Technologist
bio: Talis Reks is the VR/AR/Gaming/Big Data Technologist at MIT.nano's Immersion Lab. Talis graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Psychology with a focus in Neuroscience from Northeastern University. Talis started working in the virtual and immersive technology space during his time at Pfizer Inc where he worked within the Optical Microscopy Core exploring ways of using VR and AR for scientific research and development. After Pfizer, he became the Operations Manager and Lead Service Technician for the world's largest Virtual Reality Arena, MindTrek VR, where he brought VR gaming to the masses and built the facilities own ESports Arena for competitive e-sport game play. Before his role at MIT, Talis also spent time at Harvard Universities' School of Public Health where he led a variety of VR/AR projects involving scientific computing, data analysis, and interactive game development.

name: Terry Chen
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Terry was trained as a scientist at UCLA, spending time in the corporate strategy sector before returning to academia at Harvard University. After founding a recording studio specialized in vocal recordings and processing, he led the audio team at Modulate, getting the company off the ground in 2019. He currently serves as Modulate’s COO, overseeing all day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives founded on a unique company culture of continuous improvement. Born and raised in Boston, he is deeply passionate about building ethical foundational safeguards into AI technology.

name: Terry R. Schussler
title: Senior Director
bio: Terry R. Schussler is a serial entrepreneur, team builder, technology architect, software designer, writer, speaker, and trainer with deep experience across emerging technology and product innovation. As a member of Deutsche Telekom’s COD and PIX teams, he focuses on Next Generation Devices, including wearables, nearables, and robotics, as well as enabling technologies such as AI, XR, spatial computing, and connectivity. His work centers on trend analysis, opportunity scouting, technical research, product evaluation, and business development, helping guide ideas from concept to validated opportunity. Throughout his career, he has worked to make software smarter for users and to use technology to enable new forms of communication, interaction, and experience.

name: Tiange Wang
title: Software Designer
bio: Tiange is a software designer at IDEO where she creates human-centered and data-driven experiences through interaction design, XR prototyping, frontend development and data visualization. She had the opportunity to work across various industries in North America and Japan, and craft user-friendly and culturally-sensitive experiences for clients from a large biotechnology company to a small home care brand. Prior to IDEO, she was a design consultant to Harvard’s Fairbank Center for Chinese Studies in creating products that provide a seamless and accessible digital transformation experience for the world-renowned research institution, and collaborated with Harvard Innovation Labs in designing a venture around digital wellbeing. As a creative technologist and former architect, Tiange designs for experiences that bridge the digital and physical worlds, including novel phygital interfaces, smart homes, educational games, unmanned retail, and spatial storytelling with extended realities and generative AI.

name: Tina Grotzer
title: Principal Research Scientist, Cognition in a Complex World Lab, Project Zero
bio: Dr. Tina Grotzer is a cognitive and learning scientist who studies learning and education as it relates to complexity and navigating a volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous (VUCA) world. She is the Faculty Director of the Next Level Lab (NLL) which focuses on new visions for learning that push our ability to innovate and perform at leading edge of our competence. Her work as the Principal Investigator (PI) of the Cognition in a Complex World Lab focuses on the challenges of reasoning about complex causal forms and building instructional supports for developing sustainability-minded citizens and shifting mindsets from short-term to long-term thinking and towards more global, collective perspectives. This work included the EcoLEARN Projects where she developed virtual worlds and immersive, technology-based simulations.

name: Tom Emrich
title: Author
bio: TOM EMRICH has over 15 years of experience in spatial computing as a journalist, investor, and product leader. Sometimes called the “man from the future,” Tom is recognized as a pioneer in augmented reality, virtual reality, and wearable technology. He is the author of The Next Dimension, the definitive guide to using augmented reality for business growth. His opinions on this space have been featured in CNN, BBC, Forbes, and The New York Times.

name: Trishna Lovley
title: Principal/Director, Digital Twins
bio: Trishna Lovley is a digital transformation strategist who leads Booz Allen’s digital twin business within our Chief Technology Office. With expertise in large-scale innovation and transformation strategy, business development, and product management, she manages the implementation of digital twin pilots, prototypes, and enterprise-scale efforts. Trishna helps our clients with initiatives that operationalize digital twin technologies to address specific mission needs. Based in Massachusetts, Trishna also drives market relationships to innovate additional digital twin use cases. Prior to joining Booz Allen, Trishna worked in the digital marketing space where she developed immersive virtual and augmented reality product experiences. Trishna holds an M.Ed. in human development and psychology from Harvard University and a B.A. from Brandeis University.

name: Trista Pierce
title: Senior Digital Strategist
bio: Trista Pierce is a Senior Digital Strategist at Booz Allen Hamilton, where she is a leader on the Spatial Computing team within the firm’s Chief Technology Office’s emerging technology incubator, Bright Labs. Specializing in the convergence of XR, 5G, IoT, and Digital Twin technologies, her work drives digital transformation within the public sector. Developing practical applications and use cases while testing and incubating innovative technologies for mission-critical solutions in government and DoD operations has established her as a respected voice in the realm of emerging technology, spatial computing, and its enablers. Trista also serves as an Executive Producer to VRARA DC Chapter and Industrial Metaverse & Digital Twin Committee. Her technical expertise was forged during her time as a US Navy Nuclear Reactor Operator, and she holds a M.S. in Information Systems with a specialization in Data Analytics from Carnegie Mellon University.

name: Tristan Elizabeth Gribbin
title: CEO & Founder
bio: Meet Tristan Elizabeth Gribbin, a globally recognized meditation leader who has been guiding Healing Flow journeys across the globe, from the serene landscapes of Scandinavia to the vibrant energy of California. As the visionary behind Flow - Meditation for modern life™, Tristan is pioneering immersive technology to make meditation accessible to everyone. Through the Flow method, which blends breathwork, movement, and deep relaxation, Tristan has crafted tools and a platform to support personal transformation. 😍 Tristan's innovative approach, the Six Modes of Flow™ is woven into the fabric of Flow's VR, web, and mobile applications, as well as popular corporate wellness initiatives. The outstanding results have been recognised by industry leaders, and Flow is touching the lives of tens of thousands worldwide. Driven by a personal quest of self discovery and resilience, Tristan is committed to sharing the transformative power of meditation with the world. Her insights have been featured on prestigious platforms like TEDx, Harvard Business Review, Forbes, and BBC Click. For a deeper dive into Tristan's meditation journey, download the Flow apps, explore the Flow website, and connect with Tristan on LinkedIn. Join Tristan on her epic Flow journey to greater mindfulness, and unlocking more and more of our vast potential, within.

name: Tsitsi Kolawole
title: Product Design Director
bio: Tsitsi is a leader of multi-disciplinary creative teams that envision experiences and ship inspiring products. At Roblox, Tsitsi leads the design & research teams, re-imagining and shaping the future of immersive co-experience across entertainment, education, and productivity. She has incubated and launched industry shaping products including HoloLens, Xbox, Microsoft Surface Headphones & Earbuds and Windows 11. Her work connects humans with pioneering technologies & delightful experiences. Her teams and products explore the intersection of hardware & software experiences, XR, spatial computing, and augmented realities. Ambient computing, AI, ML, natural language and metaverse experiences are at the heart of the products Tsitsi has led from concept through launch. Tsitsi finds constant inspiration at the intersection of art & science. She trained as an architect at Harvard & MIT and as an executive design leader at Yale. She enjoys all things architecture, interior design, fashion, technology and nature inspired. Tsitsi lives in Seattle with her husband and two daughters who stretch her imagination and make her a better human every day.

name: Valentin Heun
title: VP of Innovation Engineering
bio: Valentin Heun is a VP of Innovation Engineering at PTC where he is leading the PTC Reality Lab. His work focuses on new computer interaction methods for the physical space. Valentin’s works have been published in many academic conferences such as Ubiquitous Computing, SIGGRAPH Asia, and Computer-Human Interaction conference. His work (Reality Editor) was named by Fast Company as Boldest Ideas in User Interface Design, and has received global recognition, including the SIGGRAPH Asia Emerging Technologies Prize, awarded by Wired UK to the Smart List, and received the Editor’s Choice Award for IoT Software & Tools by PostScapes. Valentin holds a Ph.D. and Master of Science from the MIT Media Lab and the German Diplom in Design from the Bauhaus-University Weimar.

name: Veronica Peitong Chen
title: Senior Experience Designer
bio: Veronica Peitong Chen is an interdisciplinary designer and artist, creating experiences powered by AI/ML and emerging technology. Her body of work engages data-informed design analysis and innovative experimentation using multimedia. At Adobe, she played key roles in multiple AI/ML initiative designs including Adobe Firefly and Adobe Express. Outside Adobe, she actively engages with AI/ML design community and exhibits her works in museums, galleries, and various platforms.

name: Virginie Maillard
title: Head of Global Research in Simulation & Digital Twin
bio: Virginie Maillard has headed the global research in Simulationand Digital Twin within Siemens Foundational Technologies since June 2018. She worksat the R&D office of Princeton, NJ, and leads teams in Germany, India andChina. She also has been responsible for the entire scope of research ofSiemens the United States. Maillardearned her engineer and MSc degrees in mechanical engineering from the NationalInstitute of Applied Sciences of Lyon (INSA Lyon) in France. Before joiningSiemens, Maillard worked for the automobile manufacturer Renault, most recentlyas head of corporate research and research strategy. Since 2017, Maillard hasbeen the president of the Scientific Advisory Board of IMT (InstituteMines-Telecom) in Paris, the biggest group ofgraduate engineering schools in France. In February 2025, Maillard was namedchair of the R&D Council of New Jersey board of directors, an organizationdedicated to advance collaboration among research institutions and strengthenSTEM education initiatives.

name: Vishal Punwani
title: CEO, Co-Founder
bio: Vishal (‘Vish’) is the CEO and co-founder of SoWork, founded at Harvard's Innovation Labs. SoWork has built the world's first generative AI-enhanced virtual workplaces, transforming productivity and team culture for thousands of teams around the globe. See more at Besides being a CEO, Vishal is a medical doctor, an Entrepreneur-in-Residence with Harvard Alumni Entrepreneurs, a Mentor at the Oxford Foundry, and Alumni Advisor at MassChallenge Boston. In his prior life, Vish worked at the World Health Organization in Geneva, and became one of the highest rated Teaching Fellows at Khan Academy in Health and Medicine. Vish likes traveling, playing videogames and hockey, and building things with smart people.

name: Waleed Zafar
title: Mission Critical Director
bio: Waleed Zafar is the Mission Critical Director of XYZ Reality, a leading developer of construction technology solutions that give owners and contractors an accurate and objective way to manage and deliver projects. Waleed joined XYZ Reality as its first employee and has led the deployment of XYZ’s platform across all major projects globally. He partners closely with mission-critical clients to streamline time-to-market and expedite project delivery.

name: Walter Greenleaf
title: Neuroscientist Medical Technology Developer
bio: Hello. I am a neuroscientist and medical technology developer. With over thirty years of experience developing innovative clinical products in digital medicine and medical virtual reality, I am considered a leading expert in the field. My research has been funded by the NIMH, NIH, and NASA. I served as the Director of the Mind Division at the Stanford Center on Longevity, where I focused on age-related changes in cognition. Subsequently, as Chief Science Officer at Pear Therapeutics, I helped develop the first digital health product to be approved by the FDA as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).Currently, I develop virtual reality systems designed to evaluate and treat a spectrum of clinical conditions, including post-traumatic stress and anxiety disorders, stroke, addiction, autism, depression, and other complex challenges in behavioral and physical medicine.I serve as an advisor to Stanford University’s Virtual Human Interaction Lab, the Stanford Wearable Electronics (eWear) Program, the Virtual Reality & Immersive Technology (VR-IT) Clinic, and the Stanford Medical Mixed Reality Center. In addition to my work at Stanford, I also advise several early-stage medical product companies and investment groups on technology and neuroscience.

name: Wendi Yi
title: Designer
bio: I am Wendi Yi, a senior industrial design student at RISD (Class of 2026), and I am planning to pursue a master’s degree in UX and interaction design.

name: Wenxin Li
title: Designer
bio: Wenxin is a designer and creative technologist exploring the intersection of spatial computing, digital heritage, and interactive systems. Currently pursuing an MLA at Harvard GSD, her work focuses on translating complex spatial data, archaeological narratives, and emerging technologies into meaningful interactive experiences. She has led and contributed to projects spanning XR storytelling, geospatial platforms, and AI-assisted design tools, and is part of the organizing team for the Harvard XR Conference. Her practice bridges design, technology, and cultural narratives to rethink how we experience space in the age of spatial computing.

name: William Cannady
title: Technical Product Manager
bio: William (“Will”) Cannady is a Technical Product Manager on NVIDIA's Enterprise XR team. He collaborates with partners and customers to improve NVIDIA's extended reality product offerings. Before NVIDIA, William worked at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and helped bring the first examples of cloud computing to XR workloads, including remote application streaming. William holds a B.S. from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse and additional education from the City University of New York. Passionate about advancing XR technologies, William contributes to several projects, including the NVIDIA CloudXR, specializes in scalable immersive experiences and cloud-based XR workflows, and holds a patent for bridging XR with traditional telephony over the web. When not tinkering with technology, he’s passionate about delivering equal access to technology, knowledge, and the outdoors.

name: Yanpeng (Cole) Leng
title: Urban Designer
bio: Entrepreneur turned product manager with 2 years of multiple 0-to-1, concept-to-launch experience in AI & Property Tech products. Cole is passionate about leveraging his background in urban design and experience in AI, VR, and urban analytics to increase urban inclusivity and thus, community social resilience.

name: Yibing Jiang
title: Indie Game Developer
bio: Yibing has dedicated 12 years to AAA game rendering, with a background that began as an artist at both Pixar and Disney Animation, she foresaw the potential of real-time rendering, driving her transition from animation films to games. At Naughty Dog, she elevated character shading for 'Uncharted 4' and 'The Last of Us II', pushing the boundaries of realistic rendering in console games. Her journey continued as a Creative Director at Unity, Yibing wrote and directed 'Windup,' a real-time rendered animation film. 'Windup' qualified for the Oscars, received a nomination for the NAACP Image Awards and received Best Animation Awards from the USA Film Festival, Urbanworld Film Festival, Indie Short Fest, and Reel Sisters Film Festivals. Notably, 'Windup' was one of the first films rendered entirely on a game engine at 30fps. In addition, she led efforts in character rendering for mobile games, introducing TressFX spline-based hair in Unity's Universal Rendering Pipeline running at 70fps on an iPhone 13. Currently, Yibing is pursuing her passion as an indie game developer, working on a prototype for a multi-platform RPG game.

name: Yiner Xu
title: Design Technologist / Media Artist
bio: Yiner Xu is a design technologist, media artist, visual designer, and illustrator. Her new media practice involves creating immersive experiences both digitally and tangibly that blend media with technology to craft interactive designs through the lens of synesthesia in connections of senses and perceptions. Her illustration explores the theme of nature in bright colors and rich textures. Her work has been exhibited at Sowa Gallery, Boston Cyberarts Gallery, Tower West Gallery, Frances Euphemia Thompson Gallery, Brookline Public Library, Harvard Art Museum, MIT Chapel, and has been selected in MassArt Auction. Her work is held in the collections of “Handel: The Creation” in the Symphony Hall. She also contributed visual projection, media design, and lighting design to performances at MIT Theater Arts and Media Lab.

name: Yiqi Yan
title: Gamification Design
bio: Yiqi is a product designer with a focus on designing useful entertainment technologies, actively exploring multidisciplinary relationships between AI, XR, art, and human cognitive augmentation. She started her career as a game concept designer, contributing her talent in both 2D and 3D to multiple AAA FPS games, including Call of Duty Mobile, Delta Force, and more, with a sleek futuristic hardcore design aesthetic. Her current and past clients include Tencent, Activision, Disney, Papergames, Bytedance. With her passion for building more responsive and interactive systems in the broad intersection of tech and gaming, she pursued her studies at Harvard Graduate School of Design, Harvard John A. Paulson School Of Engineering And Applied Sciences, and MIT with a research focus on Human-Computer Interaction and gamified product design.

name: Yiqi Zhao
title: Product Design Lead
bio: Yiqi Zhao,Product Design LeadatMeta, specializes in AI-driven spatial computing across Meta Quest products, cross-screen platforms, creation tools and wearables. Her team has delivered human-centric innovations, including the Meta Quest headsets, Horizon Ecosystem. With a research background at Harvard and MIT Media Lab, Yiqi began her 3D journey in brain-computer interfaces (EEG) and wearable AI. Previously, she led Unity’s platform initiatives, including the visionOS partnership for Apple Vision Pro. She also made her mark in the gaming sector by shipping Destiny 2. Additionally, she leads Deepcake, an AIGC community with 200 million monthly viewing. Yiqi’s vision shapes the future of immersive technologies by uniting XR and AI. Yiqi has played a creator focused role in major industry gatherings such as GDC, AWE, and the GenAI Summit. Her dedication to the community is further recognized through her role as a judge or advisor at over 30 events, including the Indigo Design Award,Creative Communication Award, Design MasterPrize,XR Design Challenge, XR Hack and MIT Reality Hack.

name: Yishui Tang
title: Designer
bio: Searching for Fun

name: Yu-Kai Chou
title: Founding Partner, Chief Creation Officer
bio: Yu-kai Chou is an Author and International Keynote Speaker on Gamification and Behavioral Design. He is the Founding Partner and Chief Creation Officer of the premium consulting/design firm as well as Co-Founder and Chief Experience of . The Octalysis Group, Metablox – an NFT platform powered by Real World Places and Real Life Memories Yu-kai is the Original Creator of the , and the author of . Yu-kai has been a regular speaker/lecturer on gamification and motivation worldwide, including at organizations like Stanford/Yale/Oxford, Google, Tesla, IDEO LEGO, BCG, the governments of UK, Singapore, Kingdom of Bahrain, and many more. His design work has and he was 3 out of 4 years by the Gamification World Congress and the Gamification Europe Conference. Octalysis Framework Actionable Gamification: Beyond Points, Badges, and Leaderboards empowered over 1 Billion users’ experiences rated #1 among the “Top 100 Gamification Gurus” in the world

name: Yun Fan
title: Founder at Future University
bio: Yun Fan is the former Lead of the Harvard iLab XR&Metaverse Community, where she co-founded the Harvard iLab Venture in Metaverse Hackathon. She is the Founder of Future University (previously Link International), an education technology company aiming at connecting Metaverse and education. She obtained her Ed.M. degree from Harvard Graduate School of Education and worked as Learning Designer for Harvard Teaching and Learning Lab.

name: Zhenzhen Qi
organization: Department of Digital Media(DMD), University of Connecticut
title: Assistant Professor
bio: Dr. Zhenzhen Qi is an artist, educator, and researcher from China, currently based in the US. She is an assistant professor at the Digital Media Design (DMD) Department at the University of Connecticut, researching software simulation as a mode of collective re-making and un-looping. She has been invited to speak at art and technology events such as Electronic Literature Festival(ELO), College Art Association(CAA), New York Creative Tech Week, International Studio and Curatorial Program(ISCP), among others. Her computational art has been curated by leading cultural institutions around the world, such as New Museum in New York, Art Basel in Switzerland, Ars Electronica in Linz, Austria, and Electra in Montreal, Canada.
